paste.introWithGrid: Copy cells in Excel (or anywhere) and paste below — Ctrl+V on desktop, or long-press → Paste on touch. On the grid itself, Ctrl+V pastes Excel-style from the focused cell. A paste here replaces the whole table — pasted headers (when included) become the column headers; blank rows are dropped.
paste.introNoGrid: Copy cells in Excel (or anywhere) and paste below — Ctrl+V on desktop, or long-press → Paste on touch. On the grid itself, Ctrl+V pastes Excel-style from the focused cell. A paste here creates a brand-new table from the block; blank rows are dropped.

help.title: Everything this table can do
help.subtitle: Right-click a cell or a column header for the full menu.

copy.title: Copy
copy.detail: Copy cell / row / selected rows from the right-click menu. The Copy button copies the rows you selected, or the whole result when nothing is selected — paste it straight into Excel.

paste.title: Paste
paste.detail: Press Ctrl+V on the grid for an Excel-style fill, or use the Paste button in the results header: the dialog paste clears the current rows and replaces the table with the block (or creates a new table before any query has run). The header row is auto-detected or toggle it with the checkbox, blank rows are dropped, numbers land as numbers, and Revert undoes the paste.

sort.title: Sort
sort.detail: Click a header to sort, or use Sort ascending / descending / Clear sort in the right-click menu.

multiSort.title: Sort by several columns
multiSort.detail: Hold Shift and click more headers to add them to the sort. Numbered badges on the headers show the order; click a header again to flip or extend its direction.

filter.title: Filter
filter.detail: Filter by or out a single value, open the filter, or clear one / all filters from the right-click menu.

columns.title: Columns
columns.detail: Pin left or right, autosize one or all columns, reset columns, and hide or show columns — all from the right-click menu. Drag between headers to resize or reorder.

editGrid.title: Edit grid
editGrid.detail: One window, three tabs: AI edit (describe a change and AI writes a Python script for the table), Data types (switch a column between text, number and date) and Add column (build a calculated column with a formula).

save.title: Save data
save.detail: Store the grid as a snapshot in the Dashboard warehouse (the Dashboard tab) so you can chart or inspect it later without re-running the query.

revert.title: Revert
revert.detail: Undo the last AI edit or paste and restore the previous table.

selection.title: Selection
selection.detail: Click a row to select it; ctrl/cmd-click or drag to select several, then copy them in one go.
